consumer: An engine dialogue/condition check (the u_has_items/npc_has_items conditional lambda in condition.cpp) asking 'does the avatar possess at least 30 rounds of 9mm?' — a yes/no the engine computes and a mission/dialogue/eligibility condition consumes.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory) — on-person, not items reachable nearby or in a map region.
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its body returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count), the engine-computed possession-with-count predicate over the character actor.
divergence: Avatar carries a loaded 9mm magazine holding 20 rounds plus a worn pouch with 12 loose 9mm rounds (32 total): the engine predicate (has_charges||has_amount, counting loaded ammo) returns true, but a re-derivation summing only loose 'charges' rows from the carried_items JSON misses the rounds inside the loaded magazine and answers false — exposing the wrong authority.
